appearance.facade_materials: Use realistic colored façade textures and materials inferred from the approved reference images.
appearance.preserve_identity: Preserve the same building geometry, openings, balconies, massing, material palette, and architectural identity across all five views.

background.style: uniform dark neutral gray studio background
requirements: no cast shadow that hides the footprint

prompt_template: Generate one consistent five-view architectural sheet of the referenced building: FRONT, BACK, LEFT, RIGHT, and TOP. Preserve the real architectural identity and use realistic colored façade textures and materials inferred from the references. Do not produce a white, gray, clay, monochrome, or untextured building. Place every view on a uniform dark neutral-gray studio background (RGB approximately 72,76,82) with strong silhouette separation. Use orthographic-like cameras, center the complete building, keep it uncropped, and make the building occupy 65–85% of each panel. Keep geometry, openings, balconies, massing, materials, and scale mutually consistent across all five views. Do not add sky, streets, vegetation, neighboring buildings, labels, people, vehicles, or ground clutter.
approval_checks: facade is realistically textured and colored
building is not white, gray, clay, monochrome, or untextured
background is uniformly dark neutral gray
complete silhouette is visible and uncropped
identity and geometry are consistent across views
